C1149.title: Expert Analysis: Building a Regulatory Framework for Algorithmic Safety in Internet Information Services
C1149.summary: In March 2022, China's Provisions on the Administration of Algorithmic Recommendations for Internet Information Services took effect, requiring providers of algorithm-based recommendation services with public opinion attributes or social mobilization capabilities to complete algorithm filing procedures.
